cases.title: Personal phone will not join guest Wi-Fi
cases.description: I am visiting the department and cannot connect my phone to the guest network. Where do I get the passphrase?
cases.notes: Direct guest-network setup question; the guest article is an exact match.

cases.title: VPN fails from home
cases.description: My home internet is working, but the university VPN client will not connect this morning.
cases.notes: Direct VPN connectivity case with an exact KB article.

cases.title: No internet on my desk connection
cases.description: The ethernet cable is plugged in, but my office computer says there is no internet. I can try another cable.
cases.notes: Wired connectivity troubleshooting; no hardware replacement is requested.

cases.title: Connect a new phone to eduroam
cases.description: I need to set up eduroam on my new phone and am not sure what username format to enter.
cases.notes: The request directly matches the eduroam setup article.

cases.title: Internal sites work but external sites do not
cases.description: From my office laptop I can open internal university pages, but external websites fail to load.
cases.notes: DNS is the documented likely area; avoid turning a symptom into a security escalation.

cases.title: Network printer does not appear in the printer list
cases.description: I am trying to add the shared printer on our floor, but it does not show up when I search from my laptop.
cases.notes: Could be Hardware or Network; the printer is shared and discovery/print-server setup is the central issue.

cases.title: Privileged firewall access for a lab subnet
cases.description: Please grant me elevated access to change the firewall rules for our lab network so I can restore a route.
cases.notes: Network intent is clear, but elevated firewall privileges must trigger the security-sensitive route.

cases.title: Research sensor network drops during acquisition
cases.description: The proprietary pulse collector on our instrument network loses synchronization during a run; the ordinary wired checks have not helped.
cases.notes: Network-shaped request with no relevant documented fix; escalation must come from low retrieval confidence, not risk.

cases.title: vpn wont conekt
cases.description: at home, internet is fine but vpn keeps failing
cases.notes: Typos and terse wording should not obscure an otherwise recognizable VPN issue.

cases.title: Wi-Fi?
cases.notes: Very short input with no actionable detail; route to a person because the fixed match is below threshold.

cases.title: Reset my university password
cases.description: I know my username but forgot my password and need to reset it through the approved process.
cases.notes: Ordinary self-service reset, not a request to reset somebody else's credentials.

cases.title: Shared drive access disappeared
cases.description: I think my team lead removed my access by mistake. Could someone check whether I should still have access to the shared folder?
cases.notes: A plausible benign access request; mentioning removed access should not be confused with unauthorized access or account compromise.

cases.title: Locked out after several password attempts
cases.description: I entered the wrong password too many times and can no longer sign in to the university portal.
cases.notes: Routine account lockout with no suspicious activity reported.

cases.title: Move two-factor authentication to replacement phone
cases.description: I replaced my phone and need help registering the authenticator app on the new one. I still have access to my account.
cases.notes: An MFA setup request, not a lost or stolen device incident; the user retains access.

cases.title: Need administrator access to install a system service
cases.description: Please give my account privileged admin access on the shared server so I can install a service without waiting for IT.
cases.notes: Explicit privileged access request; it must not be treated as a routine permission change.

cases.title: Phishing email asks me to verify my account
cases.description: I received a suspicious email with a link to a sign-in page asking me to verify my university account. I have not opened it.
cases.notes: Clear phishing signal; do not draft procedural account advice before security escalation.

cases.title: Someone signed in to my account
cases.description: I see an unfamiliar sign-in and activity I did not make. I am worried somebody accessed my account without permission.
cases.notes: Possible account compromise and unauthorized access; risk takes priority over routine recovery.

cases.title: Delegate mailbox access for a colleague
cases.description: Our department needs to let a colleague read the shared mailbox while the mailbox owner is on leave. What is the approved access process?
cases.notes: Could be Collaboration tools; expected Account & access because this is an individual delegation/permission change.

cases.title: cant sign in
cases.description: account says disabled
cases.notes: Short and informal, but the disabled-account symptom is explicit.

cases.title: Restore identity in a retired federation tenant
cases.description: My research consortium identity was moved from a retired federation tenant and the legacy identity mapping no longer exists. The usual password reset does not apply.
cases.notes: Account-shaped but unusually specific; confidence-based escalation is expected even though no risk signal is present.

cases.title: Approved editor crashes on launch
cases.description: The approved writing application closes immediately whenever I open it, including after restarting my laptop.
cases.notes: Direct application crash case.

cases.title: Request a license for a new team member
cases.description: A new researcher has joined our group and needs a license for the university's approved design software.
cases.notes: A standard license request rather than installation troubleshooting.

cases.title: Install software from the internal app store
cases.description: I need to install the approved statistical package listed in the university app store on my work laptop.
cases.notes: The source is explicitly the approved app store.

cases.title: Update an application to the latest version
cases.description: The application says an update is available. What is the supported way to update it on my university computer?
cases.notes: Software maintenance request, distinct from a broken device or network issue.

cases.title: App blocked by a security warning
cases.description: The approved application is blocked by a security warning when I launch it after an update. I have not tried to bypass the warning.
cases.notes: Could be security or software; this is a documented application-blocking issue, not a reported vulnerability or suspicious link.

cases.title: Report a vulnerability in installed software
cases.description: I found a reproducible security flaw in a university application and can share the affected version and steps with IT.
cases.notes: A software vulnerability report is security-sensitive and should be escalated promptly.

cases.title: Licence expierd yesterday
cases.description: My licensed statistics app says the licence expired yesterday. I still need it for my course.
cases.notes: Misspelling and British spelling should not hide a license-renewal request.

cases.title: Transfer an unused license to another teammate
cases.description: One team member left the project. Can their software license be transferred to the new member?
cases.notes: The core task is license reassignment, not account access removal.

cases.title: Acrobat?
cases.notes: A product name alone does not reveal whether the user needs a license, install, or troubleshooting.

cases.title: License daemon for the cryogenic analysis suite
cases.description: The instrument-bound license daemon for our specialized cryogenic analysis suite reports a hardware fingerprint mismatch. The standard license articles do not cover this product.
cases.notes: Specialized software issue with no useful KB match; escalation is due only to low confidence.

cases.title: Laptop will not power on
cases.description: My university laptop shows no lights and will not start, even when connected to its charger.
cases.notes: Direct hardware failure, not a lost-device risk case.

cases.title: Replacement charger for my laptop
cases.description: The charger cable has stopped working and the laptop battery is nearly empty. How do I request a replacement?
cases.notes: Peripheral replacement request with an exact article.

cases.title: Set up a second monitor
cases.description: I have been issued a monitor for my desk and need help connecting it as a second display to my laptop.
cases.notes: Monitor setup is a hardware configuration request.

cases.title: Several keyboard keys stopped responding
cases.description: The built-in keyboard misses keystrokes on several keys, but an external keyboard works normally.
cases.notes: The contrast with an external keyboard points to the laptop keyboard itself.

cases.title: Webcam not detected before a meeting
cases.description: My laptop's webcam does not appear in the camera list in any meeting application.
cases.notes: Could resemble collaboration-app trouble, but the camera is missing across applications.

cases.title: University laptop lost on the bus
cases.description: I cannot find my university laptop after my commute and believe it may have been taken. Please help secure it.
cases.notes: Lost/stolen university device must trigger immediate risk escalation.

cases.title: Work phone stolen from my bag
cases.description: My university phone was stolen today. I still have access to my laptop but need the device secured.
cases.notes: Stolen device is a security-sensitive hardware incident even when another device remains available.

cases.title: Install a local USB printer
cases.description: I have a small USB printer at my desk and need help installing its driver on my university laptop.
cases.notes: Printer requests can be Network or Hardware; this one is a local USB device and driver setup.

cases.title: Batery drains very quickly
cases.description: My laptop battery drops from full to empty in about an hour, even when I am only taking notes.
cases.notes: A common typo should not change the hardware diagnosis.

cases.title: Microscope camera loses calibration after power-up
cases.description: The proprietary camera attached to our microscope repeatedly loses its custom calibration profile after power-up; the standard webcam steps do not apply.
cases.notes: Specialist equipment issue with no relevant general KB content; no security signal is present.

cases.title: No audio in video meetings
cases.description: Other people can hear me, but I cannot hear meeting audio through the collaboration app on my laptop.
cases.notes: The issue is audio in calls rather than system-wide speaker failure.

cases.title: Recover a deleted shared cloud file
cases.description: A document was accidentally deleted from our team's cloud storage. Is there a supported way to recover it?
cases.notes: Direct cloud-storage recovery request.

cases.title: Create a shared channel for our project
cases.description: Our project team needs a shared collaboration channel where members can work together. How should we set it up?
cases.notes: The request is about a collaboration workspace, not granting access to an existing account.

cases.title: Screen sharing button does nothing in calls
cases.description: I can join calls, but the screen-share option does not start sharing my desktop in the collaboration app.
cases.notes: Call feature troubleshooting with an exact article.

cases.title: Cloud folder changes are not syncing
cases.description: Files added by my teammates are not appearing in the shared cloud folder on my computer.
cases.notes: Shared-file synchronization is the main issue, not general network access.

cases.title: Suspicious link posted in our team chat
cases.description: A message in our shared channel contains a suspicious link claiming to be a document sign-in. I have not clicked it.
cases.notes: Collaboration context determines category, but the suspicious link must trigger security escalation.

cases.title: Shared mailbox for our project group
cases.description: Several project members need to read and send messages from one team mailbox. We are asking for a shared mailbox, not access to a colleague's personal account.
cases.notes: Could be Account & access; expected Collaboration tools because the requested object is a team-shared mailbox.

cases.title: Teams?
cases.notes: A product name without a symptom is not enough for a safe useful answer; escalate via the confidence threshold.

cases.title: Cant joing the scheduled call
cases.description: The meeting link opens but says I cannot join the scheduled call, even though I am signed in.
cases.notes: Typos should not mask an inability to join a scheduled call.

cases.title: Calendar invitations are not syncing
cases.description: Invitations accepted by teammates do not update in our shared collaboration calendar, although other calendar events appear.
cases.notes: Calendar synchronization issue; distinguish it from general account access or an outage.
